//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Bouncier Beds -> Config

Enable Bouncier Beds.//: Whether Bouncier Beds is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

bedsPreventFallDamage.//: Whether beds should prevent fall damage when a player lands on them. It's recommended to keep this enabled if you have lots of bounciness.

bedBounciness.//: The modifier of how much a bed bounces. A value of 2.0 makes the player jump around 30 blocks. A value of 100.0 makes the player jump around 4500 blocks. min: 0, max: 100
